Fixed active docs-version resolution in `packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts`.

The resolver now evaluates version paths from most-specific to least-specific, making a root-path (`/`) version a true fallback instead of matching and freezing the dropdown on every versioned route.

Validated in the required container:

- `yarn test packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/__tests__/docsClientUtils.test.ts --runInBand`
  - 12 tests passed
- `yarn workspace @docusaurus/plugin-content-docs build`
  - Passed

Only the implementation file was modified; no tests were changed, staged, or committed.
